title: Enterprise Dedicated Bandwidth & Fiber Agreement
description: Telecom transport agreement with index-linked adjustments, 90 days termination notice, Washington law.

payment_terms.quote: Customer will remit payment under Net 30 days terms from invoice dispatch.

price_adjustment.quote: After the first 12 months, circuit MRC rates are index-linked to the Producer Price Index (PPI).

contract_term.quote: The initial term of this Agreement shall be 36 months starting August 1, 2024.

auto_renewal.quote: The contract will automatically renew for consecutive 12-month periods.

termination_notice.quote: Disconnection for convenience requires written notice of at least 90 days prior to effective date.

liability_cap.quote: Carrier's total aggregate liability for circuit interruption shall not exceed $3,000,000 USD.

governing_law.quote: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington.

volume_commitment.quote: Customer commits to purchase at least 10 Gbps dedicated continuous throughput across the network.
